text:
Ivy: FYI sparrow-v0.9 int6 onboarding shows odd locale drift: CJK punctuation spacing and bracket mirroring on RTL snippets. quick repro and a tiny metric snapshot.
Koji: drop an example?
Ivy: repro: zh input: "活动詳細(更新)"
Ivy: sparrow detok: "活动 詳細更新 )"  <-- stray space and trailing bracket flips in some RTL mixes
Alex: token id diff (excerpt):
```
- ... 820, 4120, 33, 701
+ ... 820, 41, 2033, 701
```
Priya: metrics vs sparrow-fp16: BLEU -0.5 (shortctx zh->en), chrF -1.6; embed cosine -0.05 on quick shard
Koji: repro command I ran: `./bin/eval --model sparrow-v0.9 --quant int6 --samples tests/locale/sparrow_samples.json --detok strict`
Priya: note: happens with int6/int8 and when we apply tokenizer precompile reorder (commit f4e2c3bd). likely nondeterministic mapping when precompile parallelized
Eval-bot: CI guardrail: 9/1700 failing (0.53%) above 0.25% threshold, concentrated on short CJK and mixed-hebrew/CJK cases
Ivy: short-term patch: post-detok normalize CJK punctuation spacing + force unicode fullwidth brackets for rtl outputs (ugly but reduces smoke diffs)
Alex: can you bisect with f4e2c3bd as first-bad and test tokenmap rollback + runtime kernel pins?
Koji: starting bisect now; I'll test tokenmap rollback then try runtime v2.3 vs v2.4 kernel pin combos
Priya: plan: (1) bisect to confirm commit(s), (2) full eval run (40k) with combos, (3) add unit tests in tests/locale/sparrow_edgecases.json, (4) revert or patch precompile ordering to deterministic sequence
Ivy: opening PR with post-detok band-aid + test vectors; tagging @eng-ml-leads and @eng-runtime for rollback coordination
Koji: update in thread when bisect finishes :thumbsup:
